summary: Health Catalyst, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its agreement to sell Vitalware, LLC, the entity through which it conducts its Vitalware business, to Med-Metrix, LLC via a Unit Purchase Agreement. The base purchase price is $147 million, subject to customary adjustments for cash, debt, net working capital, and transaction expenses. The transaction does not require stockholder approval and is expected to close in Q3 2026, pending HSR antitrust clearance, absence of restraining law, and at least 80% employee offer acceptance. Health Catalyst plans to use net proceeds plus cash on hand to repay and terminate its existing senior secured credit facility. Watch for regulatory clearance and employee retention risk as conditions to closing.
